what_it_does: Four mana 2/4. If you would draw a card, you draw two instead. Every draw, not just your draw step.
best_home: Blue decks that already draw. On its own it does nothing. Next to a draw engine it doubles the whole thing.
take: Put a second draw doubler alongside it and you get four cards, not three. The two effects feed each other.

more.take: Four mana in green. An extra land drop every turn, and every creature you play explores.
Eight mana 7/7 flier. Cast it and every nonartifact creature dies. It isn't one.
A land. Untapped if you already have two, and it either surveils or puts a creature back on top.

question: Is Spock making your deck, or is four mana too much for a body that does nothing?
